title: Pet Addendum Animal Acceptance Standards by Addendum Type
content:
## Leasing standards — which animals each Pet Addendum type accepts

Each type of Pet Addendum accepts a defined range of animals. The standards below state, for every addendum type, the species covered, the adult weight class, the evidence of weight, the minimum age at registration, whether the restricted breed list applies, how many animals of the type one lease may register, and the enclosure limits for caged animals.

### A. Species, weight and age

| Addendum type | Species covered | Lowest adult weight (lb) | Highest adult weight (lb) | Evidence of weight | Minimum age at registration (months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Assistance Animal Accommodation | dog, cat, bird, small caged mammal, fish, reptile | 0 (no minimum) | 0 (no limit) | Not required | 0 |
| Caged Pet Addendum | bird, small caged mammal, fish, reptile | 0 (no minimum) | 0 (no limit) | Not required | 0 |
| Cat Addendum | cat | 0 (no minimum) | 0 (no limit) | Not required | 4 |
| Small Dog Addendum (under 25 lb) | dog | 0 (no minimum) | 24.90 | Veterinary record dated within the last 12 months | 4 |
| Medium Dog Addendum (25-49 lb) | dog | 25.00 | 49.90 | Veterinary record dated within the last 12 months | 4 |
| Large Dog Addendum (50-90 lb) | dog | 50.00 | 90.00 | Veterinary record dated within the last 12 months | 4 |

A lowest weight of 0 means the class has no minimum; a highest weight of 0 means the class has no limit.

### B. Breed, count and enclosure limits

| Addendum type | Restricted breed list applies | Animals of this type one lease may register | Largest aquarium or terrarium (gallons) | Caged animals one addendum covers in one enclosure |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Assistance Animal Accommodation | No | 0 (no cap) | 0 (not applicable) | 0 |
| Caged Pet Addendum | No | 2 | 55 | 2 |
| Cat Addendum | No | 2 | 0 (not applicable) | 0 |
| Small Dog Addendum (under 25 lb) | Yes | 2 | 0 (not applicable) | 0 |
| Medium Dog Addendum (25-49 lb) | Yes | 2 | 0 (not applicable) | 0 |
| Large Dog Addendum (50-90 lb) | Yes | 1 | 0 (not applicable) | 0 |

A count of 0 in the third column means no cap.

### C. The restricted breed list

Where the list applies — the Small Dog Addendum (under 25 lb), the Medium Dog Addendum (25-49 lb) and the Large Dog Addendum (50-90 lb) — the following breeds, and mixes predominantly of them, are not accepted: pit bull terrier, American Staffordshire terrier, Rottweiler, Doberman pinscher, Chow Chow, Presa Canario, Akita and wolf hybrid. For the Assistance Animal Accommodation, the Caged Pet Addendum and the Cat Addendum the list is empty.

### D. Reading the weight classes

The three dog classes meet without a gap at the tenth of a pound, taking hypothetical adult weights as examples:

| Hypothetical adult weight | Class whose range contains it |
|---|---|
| 24.9 lb | Small Dog Addendum (under 25 lb) — at its highest weight |
| 25.0 lb | Medium Dog Addendum (25-49 lb) — at its lowest weight |
| 49.9 lb | Medium Dog Addendum (25-49 lb) — at its highest weight |
| 50.0 lb | Large Dog Addendum (50-90 lb) — at its lowest weight |
| 90.0 lb | Large Dog Addendum (50-90 lb) — at its highest weight |
| 90.1 lb | None of the three dog classes |
